title: Consolidation: overlap receipt for the fourth100 witness-MANIFEST pin family (#636/#638/#639/#640/#642/#644/#646) — one drifted larger_gain pin, partial retention, credit intact (no new kappa)
head: 2fa58df219b90bbca464466d2c69de08e8961862
body:
**Card:** `overlap-receipt` (consolidation track, priority revision 3, chooser nonce `6bc45fb7886eb99e0494a94781da0e58`, scope key `757723e3fd38f20fa774`), scope **refined** to one small named PR set. Base main `1f7a934975e5eacaf83511c9ac870263bf095e05`. No new kappa, no construction, no disposition changes; all seven PRs stay open and the selected frontier is unchanged.

**Object:** the seven entries of the fourth100 reconciliation whose contributed-package replay fails at `verify.py` line 39 with `AssertionError: larger_gain manifest pin` — https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/636 , https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/638 , https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/639 , https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/640 , https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/642 , https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/644 (vectorsss / Chi Zhao) and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/646 (jeremydiviney). This is a source-bound disposition receipt: a finite certificate of git-blob identities plus one diagnosed source-pin defect, auditing the existing fourth100 receipt (`research/community-reconciliation-fourth100-audit/`, `docs/research/community-reconciliation-fourth100-review.md`, `docs/research/pr-ledger.json`).

## Findings

**F1 — the seven failures share one cause: a drifted `larger_gain` pin.** All seven SPECs register `larger_gain` with `manifest_sha256 = 54d67f45ad520f4a134e069336bd0ff639aaeada28d13539298e4f2655c9692d`, which is exactly `research/larger-gain/MANIFEST.json` at the pinned PR569 revision `897213a855b7fb8a1b8b0e552a2f5c42e6c1b326`. The same path as staged into main (commit `df417acd`, "Stage frozen PR family through 588") hashes `73c186c2807c703e43293c7cf785557a046958c245fa812e433f7fe208cdef6d`, and this drifted copy is what all seven recorded heads carry in their base trees (checked at each head via the contents API). The two manifests differ in exactly two `files` entries, `NOTICE` and `README.md`; both are 40,559 bytes. The staged package is self-consistent at its own revision (main's `NOTICE`/`README.md` hash to the staged manifest's values). The other five pinned sources (`multicold`, `structural_gain`, `joint_prefix`, `frame_coalescing`, `direct_delivery`) still match their pins in the live repository packages.

**F2 — the six vectorsss packages vendor the pinned revision byte-exactly.** For each, every source pin resolves to its own `vendor/<name>/MANIFEST.json` and matches its registered digest in raw bytes (zero CRLF anywhere; the repository's text normalization is not involved). All pinned files match too. Run through their own `verify.sh` source overrides, the six pass the pin block the reconciliation recorded as failing; they evidently ran with sources resolved to live repository packages (as #646's defaults do), where `larger_gain` is the first failing pin. #646 has no vendored copy: its default resolution of `larger_gain` is the live `research/larger-gain`, which reproduces its failure on any checkout of main.

**F3 — retention is partial and dominated by re-vendored predecessor content** (exact blob identity against main at `1f7a9349`; no path matches at the same path and no path exists in main with different content):

| PR | changed paths | byte-retained in main (other path) | not byte-retained |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| #636 | 348 | 285 | 63 |
| #638 | 347 | 281 | 66 |
| #639 | 340 | 281 | 59 |
| #640 | 339 | 282 | 57 |
| #642 | 354 | 281 | 73 |
| #644 | 355 | 280 | 75 |
| #646 | 186 | 77 | 109 |

The unretained remainder is each package's own witness/tools/data/result files (path lists in `evidence/pr{N}-audit.json`).

**F4 — the six vectorsss members share their vendored core** (250-268 shared blobs pairwise; #646 shares 31-33 with each): one content family plus six small per-PR deltas.

**F5 — predecessor credit is present.** `CONTRIBUTORS.md` credits vectorsss for #636/#638/#639/#640/#642/#644 (line 835) and jeremydiviney for #646 (line 833). No missing attribution found for this family.

## Delta and evidence

New package `research/pr636-family-witness-manifest-receipt/` only (plus the local task card `notes/task-card-agent-22.md`): README with Open next questions, `TASK.json`/`SOURCES.json`/`VERIFY.json` metadata, `RECEIPT.json`, per-PR evidence (`evidence/pr{N}-audit.json`: pin tables and every changed path with its blob identity and class), two byte-exact `MANIFEST.json` evidence copies, and tools (`tools/audit_witness_pins.py` fetch-side, `tools/build_receipt.py`). No existing file is modified; `upstream/`, frozen sources and pins are untouched.

## Checks

- `python3 -B research/pr636-family-witness-manifest-receipt/verify.py` passes: drift identity (entries `NOTICE`, `README.md`), all per-PR pin verdicts and retention classes re-derived against `git ls-tree -r 1f7a9349` (2,269 changed paths), cross-PR shared-blob counts, one positive fixture and four failure controls (tampered digest, substituted manifest diff, omitted row, substituted class), each rejected.
- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr636-family-witness-manifest-receipt` → `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`; `--check-only` → `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` → `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`.
- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'`: 15 passed, 1 skipped, 5 errors in `test_research_onboarding.PackageTests.setUp` (Windows CRLF fixture: `write_text` CRLF vs normalized blob in a temp repo). The same module errors identically on a pristine `git archive` extract of the base commit, so these are pre-existing environment failures, not caused by this change.

## Limitations (not checked)

Head-side blob identities rest on the GitHub pulls/contents APIs at the recorded head SHAs (PR trees are not fetched locally; `verify.py` re-derives the main-tree side). The `multicold` `full_tree` manifests were not recomputed file by file. The seven packages' full contributed replays were not executed; this receipt resolves the recorded pin failure and the retention/credit question only. That the fourth100 harness resolved sources to live packages is inferred from the uniform `larger_gain manifest pin` assertion plus the pin data; the harness invocation was not recorded. Retention matching is byte identity.

## Open next questions (in the package README/TASK)

1. What source resolution did the fourth100 harness pass to these `verify.py` files? Re-running #636's `verify.sh --check-pins` at recorded head `679621828a85bac68af869fb0e55b54508e6b14b` would settle whether the six are re-run conditions rather than content defects.
2. Should main reconcile the `larger_gain` pin drift (vendor the pinned PR569 revision, or re-pin to the `df417acd`-staged manifest)? Every live-package resolution fails until then. Maintainer decision; this PR changes no pin.
3. Classify the 57-109 unretained paths per PR into method code worth retaining versus generated witness output (bounded, offline).

## Task card and scope

The full card is in `notes/task-card-agent-22.md`; scope status **refined** with reason in `TASK.json`. Overlap: the concurrent selected-replay-tooling receipt claim (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18915531) and the PR99-to-PR103 retention claim (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18912011) cover different families; https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1572 audited PR148's path gaps and is the methodological predecessor. A refreshed `find_overlap.py` pass on the concrete object terms ("larger_gain manifest pin", "witness MANIFEST", "fourth100", "pr636-family") found no receipt in progress for this family. Coordination claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18915733 .

Credit: vectorsss / Chi Zhao and jeremydiviney / Jeremy Diviney for the seven packages; the fourth100 reconciliation authors for the audited receipt and recorded evidence; the PR569 and `df417acd` staging authors for the two manifest revisions compared.
